{{Quote|But huge though it is, the Kroolok's victims never even know it's there, hiding among the trees, ready to pounce on its prey, before it strikes. By then it's too late. Yuzzums, Gorphs, and Duloks, none are safe…all devoured in a single bite…|Logray, to Kneesaa|<ref name="TK">{{StoryCite|story=The Kroolok|book=Life Day Treasury}}</ref>}}
'''Gorphs''' were an [[Amphibian|amphibious]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] who were [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="BMF" /> They possessed [[Color|green]] skin, and bluish-gray [[eye]]s with yellow sclera. Additionally, each of their [[Limb|hands]] possessed three webbed finger, and a singular protrusion was present atop their heads.<ref name="Ewoks" /> One [[winter]], the [[Ewok]] [[shaman]] [[Logray]] of Endor's [[Bright Tree Village]] claimed to [[Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|Kneesaa]] that the legendary [[Kroolok]]s could eat Gorphs in a single bite.<ref name="TK" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/ewoks-comic-series-steve-orlando-alvaro-lopez-laura-braga|text='Ewoks' Comic Series Reveals What Happened to the Battle of Endor's Most Courageous Warriors}} places [[Star Wars: Ewoks (2024)|''Star Wars: Ewoks'']] directly after the events of {{Film|VI}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]].</ref> after thwarting the [[Imperial officer]] [[Tern Koyatta]]'s [[Mission to Endor (weapons depot)|attempted retrieval]] of an [[Imperial weapons cache]], the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village invited several of their neighbors to an event, with the intent of promoting unity on the [[moon]]. At least one Gorph was present at the event, wearing a red and purple garment and handing an animal [[Bone|skull]] to Logray.<ref name="Ewoks" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorphs were first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the "[[Guide to the Galaxy]]" section of the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 38|thirty-eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine, published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="BMF" /> around [[September 23]], [[2015]],<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|38}}</ref> and written by [[Mark Newbold]].<ref name="SM">{{DMCite|dm=File:MarkNewbold-CreditsBMF.png|creator=Mark Newbold}}</ref> They were first pictured in the [[Ewoks (2024) 4|fourth issue]] of the [[2024]] [[Star Wars: Ewoks (2024)|''Star Wars: Ewoks'']] comic-book series, which was written by [[Steve Orlando]], illustrated by [[Laura Braga]] and [[Álvaro López]],<ref name="Ewoks" /> and published on [[January 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/114515/star_wars_ewoks_2024_4|text=Star Wars: Ewoks (2024) #4}}</ref>

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Gorph/Legends|Gorphs]] first appeared in "[[Princess Latara]],"<ref name="Princess Latara">{{Ewoks|Princess Latara}}</ref> the fourth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[September 20]], [[1986]].<ref name="CEL">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
